messages:
alex: Quick sync — I'm going to convert inference-workers from a Deployment to a StatefulSet so PVCs stay stable across restarts. PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/451. TL;DR: preserve ordinal semantics, use partitioned rolling update, podManagementPolicy: OrderedReady. Asking for sanity checks on replicas/rollout and any TF gotchas before I merge.
maria: sounds reasonable. A couple of things to watch: startupProbe/readiness timing (we don't want early evictions), and make sure the storageClass handles volumeBindingMode=WaitForFirstConsumer for zone placement. Also confirm preStop drain.
sam: quick Q — are we keeping HPA? HPA -> StatefulSet works but needs a controller; CPU-based HPA works if metrics-server is fine. We should avoid autoscale during initial cutover. Plan manual scale and re-enable HPA after validation?
lee: Note: Service needs to be headless (clusterIP: None) so ordinals resolve; update any DNS records or SRV lookups. Also we can't use maxSurge/maxUnavailable with STS — need to use .spec.updateStrategy.rollingUpdate.partition to control which indices are updated.
alex: yes on all that. My plan: create the STS with same labels, create headless svc, set partition to the currentReplicas (so new STS doesn't replace live pods), then decrement partition to roll new pods one-by-one. Example kubectl command I'll use to poke partition: ```
# set partition to 3 (replace pods with ordinal >=3)
kubectl patch sts inference-workers -n prod --type='merge' -p '{"spec": {"updateStrategy": {"type": "RollingUpdate", "rollingUpdate": {"partition": 3}}}}'
```
maria: also double-check PVC naming template. If we change volumeClaimTemplates shape, k8s will create new PVCs for new ordinals only. Keep storageClass + accessModes identical.
sam: for TF: you're replacing `kubernetes_deployment` with `kubernetes_stateful_set` in module/services. Make sure you `terraform state mv` the resource before applying or else TF will try to create new resources and delete the old ones. Example: ```
# move state so TF doesn't recreate
tf state mv module.services.kubernetes_deployment.inference module.services.kubernetes_stateful_set.inference
```
lee: PTAL @maria @sam when you have a minute — @alex flagged potential readiness timings. I can review the manifest and the preStop hook. If we need graceful socket drain, use `nginx`/`socat` drain or our sidecar drain endpoint.
infra-bot: CI: infra/pull/451 — plan and fmt checks passed. 3/3 tests green. :white_check_mark:
alex: thanks. One last gotcha: our load balancer currently uses endpoints from the headless svc via endpointslice. We'll create a canary by updating the LB weight to send 5% to new ordinal 0 after I create the STS with partition set high. If that looks healthy I'll lower the partition and roll the rest.
maria: Good. Let's also add an eval prompt set to the canary traffic so we can detect regressions fast (small smoke test).
sam: I'll help with the terraform state mv during the maintenance window. Schedule?
alex: thinking Friday 02:00 UTC. I'll post a short runbook in the PR and ping on #eng-oncall when starting. If anything looks off we'll rollback by pausing partition changes and scaling back.
lee: LGTM. I'll review the PR now and leave comments. :thumbsup:
alex: appreciated — will wait for reviews and then run the state move + apply in the window. Will post updates here.
